game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing. Each round, eldritch shades strike the obelisk, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the parade_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obelisk from eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard: keep the parade_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: parade_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Reverse Parade
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Parade' (Week 7 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how parade_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while parade_ok > 0.
